newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady with crude, selling pressure off.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady with crude, selling pressure off.

text.p: NWE naphtha markets were holding steady at slightly lower levels on Tuesday after crude futures reversed early losses, traders said.
They said early selling pressure appeared to have faded with a bid of around $222 for open spec barrels, some $3 higher than the previous trade, failing to find offers.
One trade house's hedging/pricing strategy has pushed prices lower recently and there was very little resistance.
A 25kt pipeline spec cargo for end-month delivery traded on Monday at $219 a tonne, $6 weaker from the previous trade on Friday.
February swaps were valued around $221.50 with March contracts pegged around $215/$216 a tonne.
